[SWS_DM_01217] Refresh timeouts
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04240
⌈
If an application calls the method
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHan-
dle::Refresh
of the class
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall perform one of the following:
• If the
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle
was returned by
the
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication::OverrideDefaultRoles
method, refresh the time period for which the OverrideDefaultRoles is valid.
Refer [SWS_DM_01209].
